title: cellgeni/nf-metacells pipeline parameters
description: Metacells (SEACells, hierarchical) from scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq AnnData

input.description: Samplesheet: one row per sample with columns id, rna, atac and metadata.
input.help_text: rna and atac take an .h5ad or .zarr store, a 10x .h5 file or a 10x mtx folder; every sample needs at least one of them. A multiome .h5 may be given for both: each assay keeps its own feature type. metadata is an optional per-sample CSV with a barcode column.

publish_mode.description: How outputs are published to the output directory.

cell_metadata.description: Cell metadata CSV for all samples: barcode and sample_id columns plus annotations.
cell_metadata.help_text: Rows of each sample are joined to its obs; cells without metadata are dropped. A sample's own metadata file (samplesheet metadata column) is used instead when given.

barcode_column.description: obs column matched to the metadata barcodes (obs_names: the obs index).

barcode_delimiter.description: Rename barcodes to <barcode><delimiter><sample id>, keeping the originals in obs['barcode'].
barcode_delimiter.help_text: Makes barcodes unique across samples and adds a `sample` obs column.

rna_counts_key.description: Where the RNA counts are: X, layers/<name> or raw/X.

atac_counts_key.description: Where the ATAC counts are: X, layers/<name> or raw/X.

allow_dtype_change.description: Accept digit-only categorical obs columns becoming integers when attaching metadata (cellgeni/adata-cli#124).
allow_dtype_change.help_text: Without it the run stops instead of changing the column type.

methods.description: Metacell methods to run, comma-separated: seacells, hmetacells.

membership_assay.description: Assay that drives membership in samples with both RNA and ATAC.
membership_assay.help_text: A sample with one assay always uses that one.

metacell_size.description: Target number of cells per metacell (SEACells, unless --seacells_n_metacells is set).

constrain_by.description: obs column to build metacells within, e.g. cell types (required by hmetacells).

eval_labels.description: obs column used to report metacell purity (SEACells).

representation_options.title: Representation
representation_options.description: The embedding of the membership assay that the methods build metacells on: PCA for RNA; LSI or a spectral embedding for ATAC; or one already in the object.

embedding_key.description: obsm key of an embedding already in the object, e.g. X_pca (skips the representation steps).

normalize_target_sum.description: Total counts per cell after normalisation (RNA).

hvg_flavor.description: Highly variable gene method (RNA); the seurat_v3 flavours read the counts.

hvg_batch_key.description: obs column: select highly variable genes within each batch, then merge (RNA).

pca_scale.description: Scale the highly variable genes to unit variance (clipped at 10) before PCA (RNA).

atac_embedding.description: ATAC embedding: TF-IDF + LSI (as muon) or snapATAC2's spectral embedding of selected features.

tfidf_scale_factor.description: Multiplies the term frequencies before their log (ATAC, lsi).

lsi_drop_first.description: Drop the first LSI component, which mostly tracks sequencing depth (ATAC, lsi).

select_n_features.description: Number of most accessible features to select (ATAC, spectral).

select_filter_lower_quantile.description: Drop this quantile of the least accessible features first (ATAC, spectral).

select_filter_upper_quantile.description: Drop this quantile of the most accessible features first (ATAC, spectral).

spectral_n_comps.description: Number of spectral components; fewer are kept when eigenvalues are not positive (ATAC, spectral).

spectral_distance_metric.description: Similarity of the spectral embedding; jaccard is quadratic in cells, use it with spectral_sample_size.

spectral_sample_size.description: Nystrom landmark cells for the spectral embedding: a count, or a fraction up to 1 (CPU only).

spectral_weighted_by_sd.description: Scale spectral eigenvectors by the square root of their eigenvalues, dropping non-positive ones.

seed.description: Random seed of PCA and the spectral embedding.

output_mode.description: Step outputs: raw directories laid out like the AnnData store, slim objects, or full copies.
output_mode.help_text: raw writes one file per element (.npy, .npz/.mtx, .csv, .json) and a manifest; slim writes an object with only the new elements; attach writes the whole object again for every step.

adata_format.description: Object format of slim and attach step outputs.

sparse_format.description: Sparse matrix files in raw step outputs.

seacells_n_waypoint_eigs.description: Number of eigenvectors for the waypoint initialisation.

seacells_convergence_epsilon.description: Convergence threshold, relative to the initial residual sum of squares.

hmetacells_n_min.description: Minimum number of cells per metacell (required by hmetacells).

hmetacells_n_max.description: Maximum number of cells per metacell (required by hmetacells).

hmetacells_n_neighbors.description: Number of neighbours of the kNN graph.

gpu_options.title: GPU
gpu_options.description: Which steps run on a GPU, and how GPU jobs are requested from LSF.

gpu_steps.description: Steps that run on a GPU: none, auto, all, or a comma-separated list.
gpu_steps.help_text: `auto` picks the steps that gain most from a GPU (pca, neighbors, lsi, spectral, seacells, hmetacells). Steps without a GPU path always run on CPU. GPU steps need an A100 or H100 (CUDA 12).

gpu_gmem.description: GPU memory (MB) requested per GPU job; 8000 MB more on each retry.
gpu_gmem.help_text: 40000 MB or more keeps jobs on A100/H100 GPUs: the CUDA 12 RAPIDS builds have no kernels for the farm's V100s.

costcode.description: LSF project (-G) for GPU jobs, needed on some queues.

help.description: Show the main parameters, or one parameter's details with --help <param>.
